question: Trace how GOV.UK's Dependabot rules changed through its RFCs, from the allowlists onwards, ending with today's rule for auto-merging external dependencies. List them in order.
gold_docs: Allow automatic patching of all dependencies
Require Dependabot cooldown for external dependency auto-merging

facts.fact: Allowlists came in with custom configuration for Dependabot
A later RFC removed the allowlists
Auto-merging was allowed for internal dependencies
Automatic patching was extended to external dependencies
External auto-merging now needs a Dependabot cooldown of at least 3 days

notes: five real documents, each amending the one before; RFC-126 is what started it

hops.quote: This is a reversal of RFC-126

hops.doc: Allow automatic patching of all dependencies
hops.quote: This is a continuation of [RFC-156]

hops.doc: Require Dependabot cooldown for external dependency auto-merging
hops.quote: [RFC-167][] allowed repositories to opt into auto-merging external dependencies

hops.doc: Require Dependabot cooldown for external dependency auto-merging
hops.quote: `default-days` >= 3
